sources.title: GitHub - izm1chael/layerfault: Offline-first local AI model admission ...
sources.snippet: Layerfault validates model artifacts and local model runtimes before inference. It combines structural validation, package inspection, integrity checking, provenance, trust, policy, runtime advisory checks, execution binding, inventory, drift detection, quarantine, and signed evidence in one local CLI.
